prompt: A shoebox has a volume of $120$ cubic inches. Its base is $5$ inches by $6$ inches. How tall is the box, in inches?
hint: Find the area of the base first — that is how many cubes fit in one layer.

hints.text: Find the area of the base first — that is how many cubes fit in one layer.
$5 \times 6 = 30$ cubes per layer. How many layers of $30$ make $120$?

explanation: The bottom layer holds $5 \times 6 = 30$ cubic inches.
Volume is layers $\times$ layer size, so $120 \div 30 = 4$ layers.
